verdict.rationale: Angular is documented as a component-based framework (angular-docs-2) using TypeScript/JavaScript (angular-gh-1). Community users describe encapsulated components that pair HTML templates with TypeScript logic, including templates written inline as strings (angular-comm-1, angular-comm-3, angular-comm-4). The 'language I already know' part is weakened by Angular-specific template syntax (ngFor, [attr]/(event)) that users say must be learned and is not valid HTML (angular-comm-4, angular-comm-20). Missing for 10: first-party docs on single-file component authoring, evidence of component-scoped styles, and markup that is plain HTML rather than framework-specific template syntax.
